faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Kipsco and our assessments.
faq.a1: A psychometric test is a scientific assessment that measures psychological characteristics such as personality, cognitive skills and work behavior. They are widely used in recruitment and talent development processes.
faq.q2: How long does the personality test take?
faq.a2: Kipsco's work personality test takes between 10 and 15 minutes. It is designed to be agile without sacrificing depth in results.
faq.a3: This version processes results in your browser and does not use a first-party backend to store them. However, data may remain on your device or in a shared link; review the privacy policy and share results only with the appropriate people.
faq.a4: Yes. When you finish you get a professional PDF report with your personality dimensions, strengths, areas for improvement and compatibility with job profiles.
faq.a5: Kipsco is designed for recruiters, HR teams, organizational psychologists and professionals who want to know their work profile.
faq.q6: Do the tests have scientific validity?
faq.a6: Kipsco tests are inspired by widely validated models such as the Big Five (OCEAN), adapted to the professional context.

guide.title: User guide
guide.subtitle: Everything you need to get the most out of Kipsco.

test.title: 1. Taking a test
test.body: Go to Tests and choose an assessment. Select one option per question and move on with Next. Use Previous to change an answer. When you finish, your results appear automatically.

results.title: 2. Understanding your results
results.body: The radar and bars show the percentage for each dimension. Strengths are dimensions above 70% and development areas are those below 50%. Job compatibility compares your profile with common role profiles.

share.title: 3. Sharing your profile
share.body: In View profile you will find the Share button, which copies a link with your encoded results. Anyone who opens it sees your profile with no account needed. You can also download a PDF.

recruiter.title: 4. Recruiter mode
recruiter.body: Ask candidates for their profile link, add it with their name, and select two or more to compare dimensions and compatibility side by side.

privacy.title: 5. Your data privacy
privacy.body: Everything is processed in your browser. Results are stored only on your device (localStorage) and the shareable link contains your encoded results: share it only with people you want to see them.

limits.title: Scope of the assessments
limits.body: The assessments are inspired by models such as the Big Five and are for guidance only. They do not replace professional judgment and should not be the sole factor in a hiring decision.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information Kipsco processes, where it is stored and what control users retain. Kipsco is a frontend application and this version does not use a first-party backend to store results.

purpose.title: 1. Purpose and responsible party
purpose.body: Kipsco, developed by Miguel Angel Canedo Vanegas, lets users take guidance-oriented assessments, view results and share a profile through a link. For privacy questions, contact elimge@outlook.com.

data.title: 2. Information that may be processed
data.body: The application may process answers, results, dates, language and interface preferences in the browser. Recruiter mode may also store the name you enter together with the result imported from a profile link. Do not enter sensitive data, official identifiers or third-party information without authorization and a legitimate purpose.

storage.title: 3. Local storage and shared links
storage.body: Results and candidates are stored in browser localStorage under kipsco_result and kipsco_candidates. Language and onboarding state use kipsco_lang and kipsco_onboarded. A shared profile contains the encoded result in the URL fragment; it is not encryption, authentication or access control. Anyone who receives the link may inspect its contents.

sharing.title: 4. Sharing and third parties
sharing.body: Kipsco does not intentionally send these data to a first-party backend. Hosting, browser, email and linked external services may process technical data under their own policies. Sharing a link, downloading a PDF or sending it by email is your responsibility.

retention.title: 5. Retention and deletion
retention.body: Data remains in the browser until you delete it, clear site storage or use the available actions to retake an assessment and clear candidates. To delete all local data, remove kipsco.com site data from your browser settings. In recruiter mode, use individual deletion or clear all; this cannot remove copies or links you have already shared.

rights.title: 6. Rights and responsible use
rights.body: You may request information, correction or deletion by contacting the address above, without limiting rights available under applicable law. If you manage candidate data, you must inform candidates, have an appropriate legal basis, restrict access and respond to their requests. Do not use results as the sole criterion to hire, reject or classify a person.

contact.title: 7. Contact and changes
contact.body: Privacy questions can be sent to elimge@outlook.com. This policy may change when the application, law or processing practices change; the update date appears on this page.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using Kipsco, you accept these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the application. Kipsco is provided as an informational and experimental tool, not as psychological, medical, legal or hiring advice.

purpose.title: 1. Service and license
purpose.body: The source code is distributed under the Apache License 2.0, as stated in LICENSE. These terms govern use of the published application and do not replace that license for redistributing the code.

data.title: 2. Guidance-oriented results
data.body: The assessments are inspired by models such as the Big Five and cognitive reasoning, but they are not a psychological diagnosis, professional certification or clinical measurement validated for every population. Results may contain approximations, errors or limitations.

storage.title: 3. Hiring decisions
storage.body: Do not use Kipsco as the sole factor to hire, reject, promote, dismiss or classify candidates. Decisions should include qualified human review, context, interviews, experience, reasonable accommodations and applicable employment and data protection law. Recruiter mode users are responsible for obtaining required authorizations.

sharing.title: 4. Links, names and content
sharing.body: You are responsible for the accuracy and legality of names, results and links you enter or share. Do not publish another person's profile link without authorization. A shared link is not private by itself and anyone who receives it may view it.

retention.title: 5. Availability and deletion
retention.body: Information stored in the browser may be lost when storage is cleared, a device is changed or privacy tools are used. You can delete results and candidates from the application or browser settings. We do not guarantee recovery of deleted data or permanent service availability.

rights.title: 6. Prohibited use and liability
rights.body: Do not use Kipsco for unlawful, discriminatory, invasive or harmful activities. The application is provided as is, without a warranty of accuracy, availability or fitness for a particular purpose. To the extent allowed by law, the developer is not responsible for decisions, losses or damages arising from use of the results.

contact.title: 7. Contact and changes
contact.body: For questions about these terms, contact elimge@outlook.com. We may update these terms to reflect product or legal changes; the update date appears on this page.
